title: Contact Centre Agent
description:
Start date: 02.11.2026

Shift Pattern: Full Time (37.5 hours)

Please note that this position is a full-time role only, and part-time hours are not available.

Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Glasgow team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Glasgow contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, discounted parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Client Engagement Administrator
description:
Full Time £26,000-£32,000

Glasgow

Onsite

This opportunity would suit someone with previous financial services experience and a strong customer service or administration background who enjoys speaking with clients and handling enquiries.

You do not necessarily need previous experience within financial advice. Experience gained elsewhere in financial services, including banking, could work well. What is particularly important is that you are confident on the phone, communicate well and are comfortable dealing directly with customers or clients.

If you enjoy keeping things organised, speaking with clients, liaising with providers and making sure clients receive an excellent service, this could be a very good opportunity.

This is a varied role where you will play an important part in supporting the delivery of the advice service. You will be involved in new business processing, keeping client records up to date, handling letters of authority, working with providers and third parties, and helping ensure Financial Planners have everything they need to support clients effectively. The role also involves maintaining accurate records, supporting pipeline progression, assisting with meeting preparation and helping deliver a high standard of service across the business.

The Business

This is a growing and ambitious financial planning and wealth management business with a strong focus on delivering high quality advice and an exceptional client experience.

The firm is investing heavily in technology, operational efficiency and the long term development of its people. It is building a modern advice business designed to make financial planning more accessible, efficient and valuable for clients, while also creating a supportive and progressive environment for staff.

This is an opportunity to join a business that is continuing to evolve, where administration is seen as a key part of delivering excellent outcomes for both clients and advisers.

The Role

Working as a Client Engagement Administrator, you will support Financial Planners, Personal Assistants and Paraplanners with the administration involved in delivering the advice service.

This is a broad and hands on role with plenty of communication with clients, providers and other third parties, so it would particularly suit someone who enjoys speaking with people rather than working solely in a back-office capacity.

Responsibilities will include taking ownership of the new business application process, processing new business within agreed service levels, working with providers and other third parties, handling letters of authority and transfer authorities, issuing documentation, maintaining accurate records on internal systems, assisting with pipeline updates and helping ensure planners are fully prepared for client meetings.

You will also deal with telephone queries, support the management of incoming and outgoing post when required, help resolve outstanding issues, and look for ways to improve processes and client outcomes.

Previous financial services experience is important, but this does not have to come from a financial advice business. Experience within banking or another financial-services environment could be a good fit, particularly if you are accustomed to dealing with customers, processes and providers.

You will need to be genuinely confident on the phone and comfortable speaking with clients and handling enquiries. A strong customer service or administration background, good organisational skills and clear communication will be important, alongside the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

Experience with industry systems or back office systems would be helpful, although training can be provided where needed.

The Benefits
- Salary of £26,000-£32,000 depending on experience
- Private Medical Insurance
- Medicash Health Cash Plan
- Pension plan with 5% employer contribution and minimum 3% employee contribution
- Group Income Protection at 75% of base salary
- Group Life Assurance at 4x base salary
- 28 days holiday, rising to 30 days after 2 years of service

Applying

To find out more about this opportunity, simply apply here.

One of our team will be in touch to talk you through the role in more detail and, if it feels like the right fit, we will support you through the interview process.

title: Lettings Administrator
description:
An opportunity has arisen for a Lettings Administrator to join a well-established company offering estate agency, letting, legal, and mortgage services, alongside regulated support for buying, selling, and property management.

As a Lettings Administrator, you will be supporting the lettings team with property administration, viewings, maintenance enquiries and day-to-day customer communication.

This full-time role offers a salary range of £26,000 - £33,000 and benefits.

You will be responsible for
- Managing day-to-day maintenance enquiries from tenants and landlords
- Handling enquiries from prospective tenants about property viewings
- Recording maintenance issues and arranging repairs with relevant contractors
- Liaising with tenants, landlords and contractors to progress maintenance matters
- Keeping property, tenancy and maintenance records accurate and up to date
- Processing property-related invoices accurately and efficiently
- Organising viewings with applicants and landlords
- Coordinating routine property inspections
- Providing general administrative support to the lettings team

The candidates from the following background will be considered:
- Lettings Administrator, Property Administrator, Lettings Coordinator, Tenancy Administrator, Property Coordinator, Lettings Assistant

What we are looking for
- Prior experience in property, lettings, maintenance or administration would be Ideal
- Confident communicating with customers by telephone, email and face to face
- Comfortable handling maintenance matters and coordinating contractors
- Strong organisational skills and good attention to detail
- Professional and approachable manner
- Good IT and administrative skills
- A valid driving licence

What's on offer
- Competitive Salary
- Company pension
- Company events

This is a great opportunity for a proactive and organised Lettings Administrator looking to build their career within the property and lettings sector.

Important Information: We endeavour to process your personal data in a fair and transparent manner. In applying for this role, Additional Resources will be acting in your best interest and may contact you in relation to the role, either by email, phone or text message. For more information see our Privacy Policy on our website. It is important you are aware of your individual rights and the provisions the company has put in place to protect your data. If you would like further information on the policy or GDPR please contact us.

Additional Resources Ltd is an Employment Business and an Employment Agency as defined within The Conduct of Employment Agencies & Businesses Regulations 2003.

title: Resourcing Coordinator (Maternity Cover)
company: Mission Aviation Fellowship UK - Agency - Permanent
description:
Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF) is seeking an organised and creative MAF in the Community (MiC) Resourcing Coordinator to support our vital resourcing and community fundraising work across the UK.

This is a rewarding opportunity for a dedicated administrator to use their skills to equip our staff, volunteers and church representatives, helping them inspire new donors and supporters to get behind our life-changing work.

Location: Folkestone or Glasgow (with hybrid working)

Contract: 12 month, fixed-term maternity contract

As an MAF in the Community (MiC) Resourcing Coordinator, you will support the day-to-day delivery of MiC UK's resourcing and community fundraising activities.

Working under the direction of the MiC Resourcing Lead, you will help develop and maintain engaging resources for churches, volunteers and other stakeholders, ensuring they have the materials and information they need to promote MAF and attract new donors and supporters.

You will also support the development of community fundraising plans, campaigns and supporter engagement, providing groups and individuals with resources and advice to help maximise fundraising income and attract new supporters.

Additionally, you will:
- Gather content for quarterly MiC Church newsletters
- Update volunteer, website, e-news and social media content
- Help develop new church and audience engagement resources
- Assist with the planning and delivery of MiC UK events
- Manage queries and meeting and speaking engagement paperwork

About You

To be considered as an MAF in the Community (MiC) Resourcing Coordinator, you will need:
- Experience in an administrative role
- Experience of working in an office environment
- Proficiency in Microsoft applications
- The ability to communicate positively, assertively and sensitively within a cross-functional team environment
- An efficient and organised approach
- The ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities
- Excellent attention to detail
- The ability to work on your own initiative
- Creativity and innovation
- At a minimum, A-levels or equivalent experience

About Us

Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF) is a Christian organisation that uses light aircraft to deliver practical help, physical healing and spiritual hope to some of the world's most remote and inaccessible communities.

For 80 years, MAF has been working in partnership with hundreds of other organisations to enable access to medical care, education, livelihood training and long-term support in over 24 low-income countries.

They believe that every community, however remote, should have access to the essentials of life - that's why MAF's flights are a lifeline, not a luxury.

The Benefits
- Salary of £28,701.28 per annum
- Annual leave entitlement of 22 days per year plus 8 paid public holidays per year
- Non-contributory pension scheme (10% of salary); employees may make voluntary additional contributions
- Death in service payment
- Flexible working policy
- Access to our Employee Assistance Programme

This is a rewarding opportunity for an organised administrator with experience to join our purpose-driven Christian organisation.

You'll enjoy a varied role spanning resourcing, community fundraising, events and communications, giving you the chance to broaden your experience, put your creativity to great use and develop a diverse range of skills.

Perhaps most rewarding of all, your work will help equip the people who champion MAF across the UK, supporting them to reach new audiences and inspire more people to get behind our life-changing work around the world.

title: HR Assistant
description:
Edinburgh or Glasgow Hybrid Working Full-Time

I'm working with a respected professional services organisation looking to appoint an HR Assistant to join their established People team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administration skills who is looking to develop a career in HR, or for an experienced HR Administrator seeking a varied role with exposure across the full employee lifecycle.

Key responsibilities:
- Provide HR administration support across the employee lifecycle, ensuring records and documentation remain accurate.
- Act as a first point of contact for HR queries, delivering a professional and responsive service.
- Support recruitment, onboarding and induction activity for new employees.
- Maintain and update the HR system, producing reports and assisting with people data requirements.
- Contribute to HR projects, process improvements, policy updates and wider team initiatives.

What we're looking for:
- Previous administration experience, ideally within HR, recruitment or a people-focused environment.
- Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and remain calm in a busy environment.
- Comfortable handling confidential and sensitive information.
- A proactive approach with a willingness to learn and contribute to continuous improvement.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a supportive team where you'll gain broad HR exposure, build new skills and play an important role within a well-established organisation.

To apply for this role, please send your CV or contact Anthony Oliva at Iconic Resourcing for a confidential chat and further details. At Iconic Resourcing, we understand that not all candidates will meet every single desired qualification or skill for the job positions posted on behalf of our clients.

However, if you believe you can add value to the role despite your experience looking a little different from what we've outlined, we would be thrilled to learn more about you.

title: People & Administration Coordinator
description:
People & Administration Coordinator
Edinburgh or Glasgow Full-time

Are you an organised administrator looking to build a career in HR?
We're working with a well-established professional services organisation that is looking for an HR Assistant to join its busy and supportive HR team.
This could suit someone at the beginning of their HR career, as well as an experienced administrator looking to take the next step into a dedicated HR environment.
You'll be someone who enjoys being organised, working with people and keeping things moving. You'll need to be comfortable managing multiple priorities, handling confidential information and maintaining a high level of accuracy.
The RoleThis is a varied HR position with exposure across the full employee lifecycle. You'll provide day-to-day administrative support to the wider HR function while also getting involved in projects, reporting and process improvement.
You'll be responsible for:
- Managing a range of HR administration, ensuring records and documentation are accurate and up to date
- Acting as a first point of contact for employee queries and providing a helpful, professional service
- Supporting recruitment, onboarding and leaver processes
- Maintaining the organisation's HR system and ensuring employee data is accurate
- Delivering inductions for new starters and supporting follow-up meetings
- Producing monthly HR reports using HR systems and other data sources
- Supporting HR Advisers with training and employee-related processes
- Coordinating work experience, summer placement and graduate recruitment activity
- Supporting relevant professional body processes
- Maintaining HR content on the organisation's intranet
- Preparing monthly HR updates and internal communications
- Producing the HR newsletter
- Supporting projects including policy updates, process improvements and GDPR-related activity
- Working alongside the Payroll Adviser and assisting with monthly payroll checks and audit requirements

What We're Looking ForYou don't need to have worked in HR before. We're more interested in your organisational skills, attitude and ability to learn.
We're looking for someone who:
- Has strong administration and organisational skills
- Pays close attention to detail and takes pride in producing accurate work
- Can manage competing priorities and work effectively in a busy environment
- Is comfortable dealing with confidential and sensitive information
- Has strong Microsoft Office skills
- Communicates confidently and professionally with colleagues at all levels
- Takes a proactive approach and looks for ways to improve processes
- Can work independently while contributing positively to a wider team
- Is keen to develop their knowledge and career within HR

Previous HR or payroll experience would be beneficial but is not essential.

What's On Offer
You'll join an established HR team where you'll have the opportunity to gain broad, practical experience across HR.
The role offers exposure to recruitment, employee lifecycle processes, HR systems, payroll, reporting, projects and process improvement, making it a strong opportunity for someone looking to develop their HR career.
You'll also have the opportunity to work alongside experienced HR professionals and become involved in wider initiatives across the organisation.
If you're currently working in administration and looking for a route into HR, or you already have some HR experience and want a broader role, we'd be keen to hear from you.

title: Claims Handler
description:
An experienced Claims Handler is required by a leading Independent Global Loss Adjusters to join their established and experienced Claims Team where you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of Property and Liability Claims cradle to grave for both the UK and Europe.

Key responsibilities:
- Investigating, negotiating and agreeing settlement of claims
- Liaising with the Insured, Insurers/Brokers on a day-to-day basis
- Liaise with stakeholders overseas
- Produce reports
- Ensure time reporting and billing is compliant
- Liaise closely with the team of Field Adjusters where appropriate
- Attend Client review meetings

About you:
- Previous Claims handling experience including caseload management
- Experience of handling Property Claims covering all general perils
- Exceptional communication skills both written and verbal
- Strong relationship management skills with the ability of establishing good working relationships with the team, colleagues and 3rd parties
- Proven capability in negotiation, decision making and problem-solving skills.
- Thrive in a high-pressured working environment
- Be driven to meet and exceed targets
- Industry qualifications, working towards or be keen to study and work towards
- Be happy to work from on office base 2/3 days per week

Salary and Benefits:
- Competitive Annual Basic Salary

Full support towards Industry qualification as well as support towards career progression and development
- Hours are Monday to Friday 9.00am-5.00pm
- 25 days holiday per annum plus bank holidays
- Healthcare Scheme
- Pension - 8% Employer, 2 % Employee
- Life Assurance
- Health Insurance
